test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Given below is a statement followed by two possible conclusions I and II. Read the information carefully and select the correct option.

Statement:

If the sheep from country K are cross bred with sheep of their neighbouring country Q, the quality of wool produced will be much better than that reared from purebred sheep of either country.

Which of the following can be concluded from the given information?

I. Any two breeds of sheep can be successfully bred with each other.

II. The demand of wool reared by purebred sheep of either of these countries might go down once the wool from the crossbred sheep is easily available in the market at comparable prices.

options.text: Only I can be concluded from the given information.
Only II can be concluded from the given information.
Neither I nor II can be concluded from the given information.
Both I and II can be concluded from the given information.

solution:
Given Statement:

If the sheep from country K are cross bred with sheep of their neighbouring country Q, the quality of wool produced will be much better than that reared from purebred sheep of either country.

Now, Conclusion:

I. Any two breeds of sheep can be successfully bred with each other - Does not concluded (Because in the statement, the particular country given and nothing mention about the any two breeds).

II. The demand of wool reared by purebred sheep of either of these countries might go down once the wool from the crossbred sheep is easily available in the market at comparable prices - **Concluded **(Because of the comparable prices the demand of wool reared by purebred sheep may be reduced).

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
